description: Spain's regulated household electricity price (PVPC, peninsula) for today or tomorrow, hour by hour in EUR/kWh, with the cheapest hours and the cheapest 2h/3h windows. Use to schedule appliances or EV charging, or to answer 'when is electricity cheapest in Spain today/tomorrow'. Tomorrow is published around 20:15-20:30 Madrid time. Data: Preciluz (CC-BY-4.0) from REE/ESIOS. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Spain tools (es_pvpc_prices, es_boe_search). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://es.redtapeapi.com/v1/es/electricity/pvpc ($0.002 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).

cheapest.description: How many cheapest hours to return (default 3)
